thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging maya (oncall) — control-plane error spike detected: 5xx rate rising across gateway (auth/orglookup/billing) — automatic page.

maya (oncall): on it. looking at dashboard. what’s the scope?

raj: seeing elevated 502/504 from control-plane-proxy -> auth-service and org-lookup. spike started ~ 2m ago.

samir: same. top downstream error: auth-token-validate timeouts, org-lookup fanout latency. customer-facing API 5xx from model serving routing.

leah (sre): adding logs — tailing proxy, grabbing p50/p95 for auth and org-lookup.

maya (oncall): ops-runbook-bot, pull runbook for control-plane deps (auth/org/billing).

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: Control-plane dependency cascade. Steps: 1) Check auth pods / restart failing replicas. 2) Throttle noninteractive background jobs against billing. 3) Enable cached-lookup fallback for org-lookup. 4) Add circuit breaker on proxy for auth to 20qps. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ctrl-deps

maya (oncall): ok. running quick checks. kubectl get pods -n controlplane | grep auth

samir: auth-service pods: auth-1/Ready CrashLoop(Backoff), auth-2/Ready, auth-3/Ready. logs show repeated "upstream timeout" for token-validate RPC.

raj: org-lookup is flapping: 3/5 replicas high GC. billing service shows connection pool saturation.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale auth replicas + restart crashloop pod. 2) add short-term proxy circuit-breaker to reduce fanout to auth. 3) enable cached org lookup fallback (read-only) for 10m. 4) throttle billing noncritical calls. Doing 1 & 2 now.

leah (sre): I can patch proxy config via config service. Patch: 
```
route {
  match: /control/*
  upstream_circuit_breaker: {
    max_requests: 20
    interval: 10s
  }
}
```
Applying now.

maya (oncall): scaled auth to 5 replicas: kubectl scale deploy/auth-service --replicas=5 -n controlplane

samir: restarting crashloop pod auth-1. logs show mem spike then OOM, but container limit unchanged. Might be cascading when org-lookup stalls.

raj: proxy circuit-breaker applied — traffic to auth dropped ~60% in 30s. 5xx rate improving from 4.5% -> 1.8% on gateway. Customer impact: ~intermittent failures for ~15% of requests routed to affected control plane paths, degrade for heavy org-lookup flows.

maya (oncall): enabling org-lookup cached fallback now (feature-flag). command: curl -X POST https://config-service.internal/flags/orglookup_cached_fallback?env=prod

ops-runbook-bot: Activated cached fallback for org-lookup. Note: will return stale org metadata for up to 30s for reads.

samir: billing throttles applied via rate-limit policy for background jobs. dropping noncritical billing calls.

leah (sre): auth pods stabilized after restart; OOM not observed post-scale. p95 auth latency down 40%.

maya (oncall): gateway 5xx now at 0.9% and trending down. Rolling mitigation looks effective. Collecting short incident summary for handoff.

raj: customer impact: briefly elevated 5xx for API requests using org-dependent routing (not all users). Spike lasted ~8m before mitigations; approx 2% of requests failed at peak. No data loss, non-blocking.

maya (oncall): open incident ticket: INC-207111 — Control-plane dependency surge (auth/orglookup/billing) -> transient 5xx. Actions taken: scaled auth, restarted crashloop, applied proxy circuit breaker, enabled org cached fallback, throttled billing background jobs.

samir: logs attached to ticket + tail snippets: ```
[auth] token-validate timeout -> upstream=org-lookup:110ms -> connect=504
[proxy] cb_open auth route -> reducing parallel
```

leah (sre): monitoring alerts muted for this incident window. setting 1h suppression for downstream alerts.

maya (oncall): handing off to night oncall leah (sre) — leaving follow-up tasks in ticket: 1) investigate root cause of auth OOM (heap dump), 2) review org-lookup GC tuning, 3) evaluate connection pool sizing for billing.

leah (sre): got it — will pick up. ETA 30m to review heap dumps and open PR for orglookup GC flags if needed.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: run postmortem checklist: collect metrics, timeline, incident annotation, customer impact statement.

maya (oncall): cc: eng-platform for possible config rollout change to prevent similar fanout cascades.

raj: thumbs up. adding note to backlog: improve graceful degradations and add per-caller rate limits for billing.

incident-bot: Incident INC-207111 created and assigned to maya (oncall) and leah (sre). Pager duty entries recorded.

maya (oncall): marking as mitigated. will update postmortem tomorrow with timeline and root cause hypothesis. :white_check_mark:

leah (sre): taking ownership for remediation follow-up. thanks everyone. :pray:
